Barbarian.name: New Barbarian
Barbarian.notes:
Rage 2/long rest (manual). While raging: +2 melee damage with STR, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing; advantage on STR checks/saves. Unarmored Defense: 10 + DEX + CON.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Barbarian.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Greataxe; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Bard.name: New Bard
Bard.notes:
Bardic Inspiration d6: 3/long rest. Spellcasting uses CHA; 2 first-level slots; choose 2 cantrips and 4 spells known.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Bard.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Rapier; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Cleric.name: New Cleric
Cleric.notes:
Life Domain starter: heavy armor. Disciple of Life adds 2 + spell level to healing spells of level 1+. WIS spellcasting; 2 first-level slots. Choose 3 cantrips; prepare WIS + cleric level spells, plus domain spells.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Cleric.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Mace; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Druid.name: New Druid
Druid.notes:
Druidic. WIS spellcasting; 2 first-level slots. Choose 2 cantrips; prepare WIS + druid level spells. Wooden shield and leather armor starter.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Druid.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Scimitar; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Fighter.name: New Fighter
Fighter.notes:
Second Wind: bonus action, regain 1d10 + fighter level HP, 1/short or long rest. Dueling fighting style adds +2 damage when wielding one melee weapon and no other weapons (shield allowed); included in this attack. Chain mail + shield.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Fighter.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Longsword; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Monk.name: New Monk
Monk.notes:
Unarmored Defense: 10 + DEX + WIS. Martial Arts d4: use DEX with monk weapons; bonus-action unarmed strike after Attack with an unarmed strike or monk weapon. Ki begins at level 2.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Monk.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Quarterstaff; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Paladin.name: New Paladin
Paladin.notes:
Lay on Hands: pool of 5 HP per paladin level/long rest. Divine Sense: 1 + CHA modifier uses/long rest. Spellcasting and Divine Smite begin at level 2. Chain mail + shield.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Paladin.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Longsword; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Ranger.name: New Ranger
Ranger.notes:
Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer: choose with your DM. Leather armor. Spellcasting begins at level 2. Longbow range 150/600 ft; ammunition and range are tracked manually.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Ranger.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Longbow; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Rogue.name: New Rogue
Rogue.notes:
Sneak Attack 1d6 once per turn with a finesse/ranged weapon when eligible. Roll extra dice separately (double dice on critical). Expertise: Stealth and Sleight of Hand. Thieves’ Cant; leather armor.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Rogue.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Shortbow; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Sorcerer.name: New Sorcerer
Sorcerer.notes:
CHA spellcasting: choose 4 cantrips and 2 first-level spells known. 2 first-level slots. Choose a sorcerous origin with your DM; adjust HP/AC for Draconic Bloodline if chosen.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.

Warlock.name: New Warlock
Warlock.notes:
CHA spellcasting. Pact Magic: 1 first-level slot recovered on a short or long rest (restore manually after a short rest). Choose 2 cantrips and 2 first-level spells known; choose a patron with your DM.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
Warlock.inventory: Explorer’s pack; Dagger; starting armor as noted. Complete the loadout with your DM.

Wizard.name: New Wizard
Wizard.notes:
INT spellcasting. Choose 3 cantrips and six first-level spells in your spellbook; prepare INT + wizard level spells. 2 first-level slots. Arcane Recovery once/day after a short rest; restore manually. Spell attack +5; save DC 13.

Loadout abilities are final scores for a normal human. Finish race, background, proficiencies and equipment with your DM.
